title: Tai Phake Primer (Lik Lai Phake)
author: Margherita & Naharkatiya Tai Literature Committee
description: Foundational community language textbook published for native Tai Phake village schools in Namphake, Tipam Phake, and Margherita in upper Assam, serving as an indispensable twin linguistic resource for understanding Tai Khamyang phonology, initial consonant clusters, diphthongs, tone indicators, and everyday rural vocabulary.

sentences.text_roman: lik lai tai pha ke pen lik söp ma ti pu mawn nai ya
sentences.assamese_script: লিক লাই ত্তাই ফা-কে পেন লিক চুপ মা তী পূ-মৌন নায়-য়া
sentences.free_translation_en: The written script of the Tai Phake is an ancestral legacy inherited from our revered forebears.
sentences.free_translation_as: টাই ফাকেসকলৰ লিখিত লিপি হৈছে আমাৰ ককা-আইতাহঁতৰ পৰা উত্তৰাধিকাৰ সূত্ৰে পোৱা এক পৱিত্ৰ সম্পত্তি।
sentences.speaker: Ven. Gyanasri Mahathera

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai Khamyang and Tai Phake speak dialects that are remarkably close and mutually intelligible.
